text: dsh-personal-center（DSH Web 插件）：在设置中提供本地个人中心，汇总 Token 用量、会话数量、工具调用、模型成本和使用趋势，并支持会话回顾。用户可设置全局个性化指令、调整外观与字号，还可启用按真实使用状态变化的桌面宠物并查看会话概览。适合希望在 DSH 内管理使用情况和个人偏好的用户。

dsh-personal-center adds a local settings hub for DSH usage statistics, sessions, tool calls, model cost, and activity trends. Users can review sessions, set global custom instructions, adjust appearance and font size, and enable a desktop pet with session status.

dsh-personal-center README · dsh-personal-center：> A local, offline personal center for DeepSeek Harness — usage stats, cost estimation, custom instructions, global font size, and a desktop pet.

A local plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) desktop / web. Adds a **Personal Center** section to Settings, with three tabs:

dsh-personal-center README · dsh-personal-center：- **Token Usage** — real usage stats: today / cumulative tokens, session count, tool calls, a GitHub-style activity heatmap (daily / weekly / cumulative), per-provider breakdown (with per-model detail), top tools, and session review; with sub-tabs (Overview / Review / Model Cost).
- **Personalization** — global custom instructions (like ChatGPT / Codex "Personalization → Custom instructions"), applied to all chats on this machine.
- **Desktop Pet** — bitmap (black / blue whale) and vector ("round black / round blue") skins, driven by your real usage (5 emotions), with a session-status overview (double-click a session to jump into it).

dsh-personal-center README · dsh-personal-center：**Model cost estimation** lives inside Token Usage: per-model pricing (peak / off-peak, per currency, official presets) plus cache-hit-rate stats.

100% local — no network, no reading chat content. See [PRIVACY.md](PRIVACY.md). Bilingual UI (中文 / English), follows DSH's language automatically.

dsh-personal-center README · Token Usage (statistics)：Data source: aggregates local session logs (session.v4 / session.v3 / legacy) in real time — numbers only, never reads content. See [docs/common/DESIGN.md](docs/common/DESIGN.md).

dsh-personal-center README · Personalization (layered instructions: v0.7)：- The engine scans all stylesheets for DSH `--dsw-font-*` tokens and hard-coded font-size rules, then offsets everything by "current − 14" via a `<style>` override layer — **at the default 14 the layer is empty and the UI is 100% untouched**;
- Only shifts global font size, never touches other modules' layout; local, zero network.

dsh-personal-center README · Method 1: Plugin console / CLI (recommended)：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:PolinniZhong/dsh-personal-center
```

Or: Web GUI → Settings → Plugins → Plugin Console, search "个人中心".

dsh-personal-center README · Method 2: Local development (link dependency, same as dsh-omi-voice)：1. Clone this repo anywhere;
2. Add to your profile's `package.json`:

```json
   "dsh-personal-center": "link:/absolute/path/to/DSH 个人中心"
   ```

3. Add `"dsh-personal-center"` to the `dsh.profile.bundles` list;
4. Restart DSH.

> Note: if `node_modules` has no package after restart, symlink manually:
> `ln -s /absolute/path/DSH 个人中心 <DSH_HOME>/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-personal-center`
